one_liner: Save any clue about a person. Circle brings back the right person when they can help.
category: personal contact memory and grounded relationship recall for independent operators
supersedes: Descriptions of an active two-tab Plan/Circle product, a relationship-to-revenue engine, overnight drafted Moves, or $30/$79 tiers are retired.
primary_user: Fractional executives and independent operators who meet useful people but do not want to maintain a CRM.
anti_icp: Sales teams needing deal stages, seat management, pipeline administration, or automated outreach.
active_flow: Add a name, link, email, note, voice clue, photo, supported device contact, or Android PWA share.
Check only uncertain details. A name is required; where you met is optional.
Tap Keep clue once. Circle preserves the raw clue and uses the existing dedupe pipeline.
Later ask for a named or described person, or describe an idea being tested.
Circle returns a saved person with a reason grounded in stored evidence.
live: One adaptive capture and recall surface
Text, link, email, voice, photo, supported device-contact, and Android PWA share intake
Exact saved-name recall without an LLM or paid search dependency
Provider-backed broader search and idea ranking with grounded local recovery
not_shipped: Native iOS share-sheet intake or an official Apple Shortcut
Guaranteed interest, availability, or relationship strength
trust: Nothing saves until the user taps the save action.
Exact saved-name recall degrades independently of remote AI providers.
Circle never sends a message automatically.

pricing.note: Wider network search may be plan-gated. Exact recall of a person already saved is not.
